The Appeal is filed under S.4 of the High Court Act praying to set
aside the order dated 10.4.2013 in Wp 100789/2013 and quash the notice
dated 23.1.2013 issued by the 5th respondent, etc.
 The Appeal coming on for Orders this day, Huluvadi G Ramesh J.,
delivered the following:-
 Judgment
Appeal is against the dismissal of the writ petition filed by the petitioner seeking to quash the order at annexure H dated 23.1.2013.
Heard the counsel representing the parties.

According to the counsel for the appellant, by a common order, learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench had directed the respondent authorities to conduct inspection within three months from the date of order with regard to maintaining standard in supply of packaged water in the Unit and whether they have ISI mark or not.

In this regard, the grievance of the appellant is that, despite submission of the application as per the direction of the learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench,
respondent authorities have not visited the plant as to whether there is compliance or not and more than three months have lapsed.
Rather, they have proceeded to issue a notice as per annexure H dated 21.3.2013 demanding the appellant to close down the unit.

The grievance of the appellant is, when the application already filed as per the direction of this Court was pending consideration, without processing or complying with the order to comply with the minimum standard as required (ISI specification), unilaterally notice has been issued and also the matter is taken up before the learned Single Judge and the order passed therein so far is not released.
Meanwhile, petitioner/appellant is before this Court seeking to quash the notice dated 21.3.2013.

At the outset, it was for the respondent authorities to have considered the application filed by the appellant as per the general direction issued by the learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench to inspect the Unit with regard to supply of packaged water as per ISI specification.

Without compliance, rather they proceed to initiate action to close down the Unit of which the appellant being aggrieved moved WP 10789/2013, and learned Single Judge has dismissed the writ petition Smt. Meena W/O Shankerlal Jat vs Union Of India Represented By Its ... on 19 April, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107810530/
2 itself in stead of quashing the notification.

sentences.text: The respondent authorities have proceeded to issue notice hurriedly without compliance of the earlier direction issued by the learned Single Judge of the Principal Bench.
The learned Single Judge of this Court would have taken note of the fact to quash annexure H dated 23.1.2013.

In our opinion, the issuance of notice by the respondent authorities being premature, without compliance of the directions issued by the learned Single Judge earlier, the notice dated 2.3.12013 is quashed.
It is for the respondent authorities to take action as per the directions issued earlier, within one month.
Thereafter, if there is any deficiencies, it is at liberty to take action, according to law.
Appeal is allowed.
